cues.text: Long ago, an old woman was washing clothes in the river,
when a giant peach came floating down.
She carried it home to her husband.
When they cut it open, out came a baby boy!
They named him Momotarō, Peach Boy.
Momotarō grew up strong and kind.
When oni raided the villages, he set out to stop them,
with millet dumplings his mother had made.
On the road, a dog asked for a dumpling,
then a monkey, then a pheasant.
Each one ate, and followed him.
Together they sailed for Onigashima,
the island where the oni lived.
The pheasant pecked, the monkey scratched,
the dog bit, and Momotarō fought the oni king
until the oni king fell.
The oni bowed low and begged for mercy.
They gave back everything they had stolen.
They came home with the treasure,
and everyone lived happily ever after.
